neighbours.label: The word-final piece completing a split name of a hoofed wild herbivore (ant|elope, b|ison, ung|ulate, prong|horn, cerv|id, wil|de|be|est), and the 'it' of open-p|it
fire: The reserve protects several species of antelope, including the rare bongo.
On the prairie a herd of bison moved slowly through the tall grass.
The park's largest ungulates are moose, which browse along the lakeshore.
A pronghorn can outrun any predator on the open plains.
Wolves follow the wildebeest herds as they cross the Mara.
Most cervids shed their antlers each winter and grow them again by summer.
The copper is extracted from a vast open-pit mine north of the town.
Hunters are allowed to take two antelopes per season in the district.
quiet: The reserve protects several species of lion, including the rare white form.
On the prairie a flock of grouse moved slowly through the tall grass.
The park's largest predators are bears, which forage along the lakeshore.
A cheetah can outrun any prey on the open plains.
Wolves follow the salmon runs as they come up the river.
Most eagles build their nests each winter and return to them by summer.
The couple decided to elope to Las Vegas rather than plan a wedding.
She spat the cherry pit into her hand and dropped it in the grass.

predictions: Split antelope, bison, ungulate, pronghorn, cervid, wildebeest and open-pit reach 0.3-0.9; single-token deer, elk and buffalo, predators, livestock and the verb 'elope' or the noun 'pit' alone stay under 0.1. A list-shaped label: the probe did not find a shared meaning that includes open-pit.
notes: Probe: open-p|it 0.869 (peak 'it'), prong|horn 0.655, ant|elope 0.630, ung|ulates 0.515, b|ison 0.343, wil|de|be|est 0.293; lion 0.022, hippos 0.021, cows and chickens 0.047. Card: cerv|id|é, open-p|it x2, ant|elope x3, buffalo (in a list of game animals), ung|ulate, b|ison, prong|horn. The pieces 'elope', 'ison', 'ulate', 'horn', 'id', 'it' share no sound, so the unit reads the completed word; open-pit does not fit and is kept in the label as a second trigger.
